recipe.name: Green Lentil Dahl with Tomato, Bell Pepper, Cilantro, Yogurt & Naan

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 green bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to bowl with the green onions.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, rinse lentils in a colander or strainer.

Once the veggies are done, add lentils, tomatoes, and broth to the pot; stir to combine the dahl and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until the lentils are just tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the lentils are done, add cilantro to the pot and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Toast naan if desired, then cut into wedges.
Divide dahl between bowls, then top with yogurt and reserved green onions. Serve with naan on the side and enjoy!

recipe.name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Feta & Tzatziki

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml (3 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ lemon
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Juice the lemons into a small bowl; pour ½ of the juice into the quinoa (save the rest for the tzatziki sauce).
Once the quinoa is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove the saucepan from the heat and let the quinoa stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Small dice a ⅓ of the cucumbers and add to the remaining lemon juice; halve the other ⅔ of the cucumbers lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Add to the tomatoes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chops the leaves. Add to the tomatoes and cucumber.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice and cucumber.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper, then rub with olive oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean cutting board.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice, cucumber, and garlic; mix together and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Measure out the olives and add to the vegetables.
Measure out the feta and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the bowl.
Cut the chicken crosswise into bite-sized strips and add to the bowl. Toss the ingredients until well combined.
To serve, place the quinoa mixture into a bowl and spoon the tzatziki sauce over top. Enjoy!
